mapper.select:
select pa.*,g.goods_name,s.supplier_name from purchase_apply as pa inner join goods as g on g.goods_id = pa.goods_id inner join supplier as s on s.supplier_id = pa.supplier_id where 1=1
and g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{goodsName},'%')
and s.supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{supplierName},'%')
order by pa.apply_time desc
